final_message: Fixed in `include/fmt/ranges.h`. The formatter forwarded temporary subranges as rvalues and skipped nested default parsing, causing compilation failures and missing quotes. It now retains elements as lvalues during formatting and propagates parsing to nested formatters. Added regression coverage without changing existing tests.
